purpose: Trace the nine audit work items to implementation and evidence. Final test outcomes are recorded separately; this map is not independent certification.

items.change: Separate recommended presence from supplied-value correctness; advisory omission or unavailable advisory evidence alone is nonblocking.
items.boundary: Section 7.5 does not mandate original attachment bytes; stored native-byte metadata agreement remains independently required.

items.change: Separate email schema, cardinality, original-conditioned Core Field presence and source-value fidelity. Keep field identity in each finding.
items.boundary: A creator reader snapshot proves its parsed record survived emission, not recovery of every native storage property. Absent isolated originals are N/A; supplied unreadable originals remain unavailable.

items.change: Separate email content-set ownership from identifier membership.
verification: Integration: wrong email owner passes GUID membership and fails ownership
items.boundary: Document-wide front matter/report exceptions and unavailable evidence remain explicit.

items.change: Separate attachment-icon presence from visibility and complete CropBox containment.
verification: Integration: clipped icon passes presence and fails visibility
items.boundary: Each applicable owning body set requires a qualifying annotation. Extra decorative annotations need not all qualify.

items.change: Separate conditional MIME-parameter presence, PDF-string type, original fidelity and native/XMP consistency. Preserve parameters in creator output.
verification: Integration: parameters omitted from both native metadata and XMP
items.boundary: XMP cannot independently prove what the original supplied. Known absent native MSG MIME properties differ from unreadable or ambiguous evidence.

items.change: Label the used-custom-tag interpretation and retain the complete source trigger. Resolve the Document root through the applicable role map.
items.boundary: Used-only scope is local policy, not adopted errata. Published namespace and legacy compatibility-map requirements remain.

items.change: Separate number type from attributable rendered count and body media type from attachment-rendering media type.
verification: Integration: wrong count and body type
items.boundary: Do not count all input messages or assign identical source occurrences by checksum alone. Unsupported companion counts are omitted.

items.change: Make completed veraPDF validation of finished bytes the PDF/A prerequisite, with separate applicable ISO/TS 32005 validation. Keep viewer claims factual.
verification: Real primary and PDF/A-only sidecar reports
Viewer unit and Chromium browser evidence
items.boundary: Sidecars do not acquire EA-PDF requirements. Viewer inspection is not validation. Fresh Firefox runtime testing was unavailable.

items.change: Use 229 page-ordered top-level rules, retain 301 source records and 418 linked contexts, and preserve all Finding occurrences. Distinguish each current predicate from full linked clauses.
items.boundary: Traceability and tests do not certify perfect extraction or every permitted representation. Historical results cannot be carried over automatically to newly split predicates.

known_cross_validator_limit: For two historical headerless MSG fixtures, Python can use readable native recipient tables to prove a field-specific To contradiction. Java currently stops its universal comparison at the recovered-header boundary and reports unavailable. This is retained as a narrower Java evidence capability; it is outside the passing 15-file parity set.
